author: Linnaeus, 1766
summary: 흔하지 않은 여름새로, 소택지와 논, 강가 풀숲 등지에서 지낸다. 풀숲 땅 위에 식물 잎과 줄기로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고, 크림빛이 도는 갈색 바탕에 붉은 갈색과 쥐색 얼룩이 많은 알을 5~9개 낳는다. 우리나라 전역과 만주 남부, 중국 동부, 일본 등지에 분포하며, 중국 동부와 미얀마, 시안 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Ruddy-breasted Crake (Zapornia fusca), adult as seen in Korean marshes and rice paddies from May to August: crown, hindneck, upperparts, wings and tail plain dark olive-brown without streaks or spots; face, sides of the neck, breast and upper belly rich ruddy chestnut; chin and upper throat whitish; lower belly, rear flanks and undertail coverts dark greyish-brown with narrow white bars. Short, straight greenish-brown bill; bright red iris; legs and toes red.
art.pose: walking at the edge of a grassy marsh, half-hidden among stems
art.scene: Korean summer marsh and rice-paddy edge with dense riverside grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking at a marsh edge: plain dark olive-brown upperparts, rich ruddy chestnut face, breast and upper belly, greyish-brown lower belly and undertail barred white, short greenish bill, red eye, red legs
adult, head detail: ruddy chestnut face with a whitish chin, short straight greenish-brown bill, bright red eye, plain olive-brown crown
art.build: Small, compact crake, 22.5cm long, about the length of a starling but rounder, with a laterally compressed body. Small head, short neck. Bill short (shorter than the head), straight and pointed, without a frontal shield. Legs medium length with long toes. Short tail often cocked and flicked, showing the barred undertail. Stays close to cover; flies weakly with legs dangling.
avoid: Do not paint white bars on the wing coverts or a greyish head — those mark Band-bellied Crake (Zapornia paykullii).
Do not paint black-and-white streaks on the back — that is Baillon's Crake.
Do not paint a long red bill like a rail; the bill is short and greenish.
Do not paint yellow or green legs; they are red.
